title: KACE: Knowledge-Adaptive Context Engineering for Mathematical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2606.00532v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Context-engineering methods improve a frozen language model by learning text from execution feedback and placing it in the prompt. When one learned prompt carries everything that was learned, irrelevant lessons compete with relevant ones, and the system can keep only what fits in that prompt. We present Knowledge-Adaptive Context Engineering (KACE), which decides per problem both how much inference to spend and which learned knowledge to show. A fixed tiered self-consistency schedule (2, 3, then 5 samples behind agreement gates) lets easy problems exit after two agreeing samples, and the tier at which a problem exits serves as its difficulty label. Offline, a teacher-guided learner distills failed training traces into short typed cards kept in a store partitioned by difficulty tier and domain, and each escalated tier reads only the cards of its (tier, domain) cell. On MATH-HARD, KACE reaches 77.3% against 72.7% for Best-of-5 self-con

translated_title: KACE：面向数学推理的知识自适应上下文工程
translated_abstract: 上下文工程方法通过从执行反馈中学习文本并将其放入提示词中，从而改进冻结的语言模型。当单个学习到的提示承载了所有学到的内容时，无关的经验会与相关的经验相互竞争，而且系统只能保留适合放入该提示的内容。我们提出了知识自适应上下文工程（KACE），它针对每个问题同时决定投入多少推理量以及展示哪些学到的知识。一个固定的分层自洽调度（依次为 2、3、5 个采样，并设有一致性门控）使简单问题在两个一致的采样后即可退出，而问题退出的层级则作为其难度标签。在离线阶段，一个由教师引导的学习器将失败的训练轨迹提炼为简短的类型化知识卡片，保存在按难度层级和领域划分的存储库中，每个升级后的层级只读取其对应的（层级，领域）单元格中的卡片。在 MATH-HARD 上，KACE 达到了 77.3% 的准确率，而 Best-of-5 自洽方法为 72.7%。
tldr: KACE 提出知识自适应上下文工程框架，通过分层自洽调度为每个问题自适应分配推理预算，并按难度层级和领域检索提炼出的知识卡片，在 MATH-HARD 上将准确率从 72.7%（Best-of-5）提升至 77.3%。
en_tdlr: KACE adaptively allocates inference budget per problem via a tiered self-consistency schedule and retrieves distilled knowledge cards filtered by difficulty tier and domain, boosting MATH-HARD accuracy from 72.7% (Best-of-5) to 77.3%.
